notes.title: Life and Love update Part 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I am happy to announce the part 2 to the Life and Love update for Ebonside!





Here is the list of changes and added features with the part of the update!



Added Kakata Racing. Players can now race their current kakata to race for points, money

and spells for Blackmage!

Fixed the hunters guild showing the wrong quest in the quest section

Add the Duke of Zen'ja Questline. Take on a short questline to discover the dukes secrets and

put an end to his evil!

Added Kakata Digging, allow the player to dig up new items in all outside areas!

Fixed some balancing regarding some monsters.

Fixed some spelling.

Fixed Dark Zone to scale while doomed as well as target all monsters.

Fixed Sneak Attack.

Added two new songs to replace the place holders.



Thank you all for your support and I will be working on more stuff! I am dealing with a lot with life but I

am still trying to post updates as fast as I can. If you find a bug, do post it here or the discord!

notes.title: Dev Log: Adding new stuff
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just wanted to post a devlog of all the things I have be up to with the next update of Ebonside. A lot of new stuff is coming when I can get the time to complete it.

Here is a list of all things I am planning on adding to the game.


 Adding Kakata Racing. Yes I am finally adding the ability to race these damn birds, but its in a way that isn't like normal racing, its state based. So if you raise a Kakata with crappy stats, you most likely wont win most the time.

 Adding a new questline. I am adding a small questline that takes play in the city of Zen'ja. Scaled for lv 80-99. This questline gives ya two new bosses to test your party! As well as new weapons and armor!

 Adding more the Kakata Digging. This update will bring the digging mechanic to kakatas, allow you to dig up area items and maybe start some new quests!

 Adding the Encyclopedia. I have gotten complaints about not having a book that tells you about a monster or item. So I am adding one to the game, where you can find it in the first monsterhunters guild in yon' yen.

 Jerry.

notes.title: V1.7.6 Life and Love Update.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today I have amazing news, I have been working really hard on ebonside!
As of y'all know. I have been going through it lately, getting evicted, getting laid off, having my flipping house burn down. I have had my fair share of crap lately, but today I am glad to announce Ebonside's

Life and Love Update


Features that I added include are the following:

[olist]
Monster hunter guilds all over Mest Jest! Strike down those NM's and get rewarded for it!
An MHG has been added to Ja'dolin and P'ran, with new bounty quests!

NPC Lore! Each city has been updated to have more NPCs with special dialog for each npc, from complains about life, to lore about the city. The world of Mest Jest has gotten bigger and ready to explore!

Fixed/Added new Quests. Hop into the new bounty quests as well as some new quests in some cities!
I have also fixed some quests not working/ not appearing.

Nerfed Dethard, unfortunately he was able to learn spells that made him really fricking overpowered then what he already is. He is no longer able to learn spells like "Death Count" and "Omega". If you already have these spells in your save, then Ignore this.   

General bug Fixes, I have fixed a multitude of bugs ranging from "oh that's weird" to "That's game breaking". These bugs included the Orb stack glitch, which allowed for max stats on weapons and armor, to combat this. Once you augment a piece of equipment, it is permanent. So choose wisely.

Beast-master fixes. I believe I have fixed the problem with Beast-master regarding the monsters bugging out the system. The problem with it was that it was trying to read every single weapon that could be Duel Wielded, and since all the weapons besides the broths didn't have a sprite. It would cause an error. This has being fixed and tested on my end, but I can't say it won't break. Just because during my testing it worked as intented.

Reworked Kakata Raising. You can know have kakatas with stats! The main one being Loyalty. The stats currently don't do anything as of right now. But, in the next update they will play a big role in events like
Kakata racing, digging and fighting. That's right, fighting. Bird Up.   

 NPC Recognitions. Npcs in towns will give special dialog regarding to who is in your party, so keep a look out!

[/olist] 


Thank you all for baring with me these couple of months, I say this again. I am sorry, I really love this project and I want to continue working on it. This is my baby, and it takes me back to my days of FFXI.

With everything going on in my life, it has gotten harder to work on it. But rest assured. The DLC will come out, and you guys will get to enjoy all the new content that comes with it.

If you want more updates regarding Ebonside, do think about joining the Discord! Until then 
Enjoy the new update and if you find any bugs, either make a post on the discussions board or post
them in the #Bugs tab in discord.


-Distant

notes.content:
Hello! I come baring gifts! 

Ebonside has obtained its first big update in a while!

1.4.0!

What does it add? Well, it reworks some systems and adds new content!


 Reworked First Dark Tower dungeon
 Reworked Kakata Raising System. [note: Stats don't do anything yet. Still working that one out]
 Reworks Artifact Gear [Can now obtain ART gear from quests.]
 Fixed Minor Bugs
 Replaced Real Life Time clock with Hourly time clock! A full day in ebonside is now 1 and a half hours.

Thank you all who still support the game. It really means a lot. And I promise to get the DLC out when I can!


-Distant

notes.title: Dev Log 1#
notes.content:
Hello! I just want to let everyone know how the game is going!

Starting with a few updates that is going to be released to the demo.


 Thief will have more skills
 Fix Kakata black out screen with the other classes
 Fix the EXP bars no loading
 Fix some grammar and spelling mistakes 
 Adding the magic compass


Ebonside in terms of development is about 67% done. With chapter 2 being finished.

The homestead has been fully complete. You can know garden, chop trees and mine from the respected
harvesting outlets. 

I'm adding a sleeker look to the HP/MP bars unlike the one in the base demo.

The Magic compass will be added in the following days since people have told me. That they get lost in the cities and outside to quickly, The Magic Compass is a fix to that. It will pin the icon of a store, inn or
house in the bottom right hand corner!  

Regarding my English, since I have had people ask if it's my native langues. It is, I have just never been able to spell properly due to brain problems I suffer with. Luckily for me, I have friends that are helping me with the making of the game. And, helping me with spelling, grammar and other stuff.

Thank you for reading, and stay tuned for the release! 


-Dia
